mapper.sql: t.id AS id, t.dict_code AS code, t.dict_name AS name, t.description AS description, t.status AS status, t.version AS version, t.updated_at AS updatedAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_dict_item i WHERE i.dict_type_id = t.id) AS itemCount
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_dict_type t ORDER BY t.dict_code
SELECT FROM sys_dict_type t WHERE t.dict_code = CONVERT(#{code} USING ascii) COLLATE ascii_bin
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_dict_type (dict_code, dict_name, description) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_dict_type SET dict_name = #{name}, description = #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, status = #{status}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
mapper.select: SELECT i.id AS id, i.dict_type_id AS typeId, i.item_value AS value, i.item_label AS label, i.description AS description, i.sort_order AS sortOrder, i.status AS status, i.version AS version, i.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM sys_dict_item i WHERE i.dict_type_id IN #{id} ORDER BY i.sort_order, i.id

SELECT i.id AS id, i.dict_type_id AS typeId, i.item_value AS value, i.item_label AS label, i.description AS description, i.sort_order AS sortOrder, i.status AS status, i.version AS version, i.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM sys_dict_item i WHERE i.dict_type_id = #{typeId} AND i.item_value = CONVERT(#{value} USING ascii) COLLATE ascii_bin
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_dict_item (dict_type_id, item_value, item_label, description, sort_order) VALUES (#{typeId}, #{value}, #{label}, #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_dict_item SET item_label = #{label}, description = #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, status = #{status}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
